description: DeFi TVL by protocol and chain: total DeFi TVL and the 15 largest chains with 1/7/30-day change, and protocols ranked by TVL or 1/7-day change, each with category, market cap to TVL, largest chains with their share, and flags such as tvl-down-20pct-7d or one-chain-90pct. Look up a protocol by name or slug, or filter by chain (ranked by its TVL there) and category. 1,200+ protocols with $1M+ TVL from DefiLlama, refreshed every 2 hours. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
